observations.observation: Read all2704characters. The summary follows a four-perspective structure. It first defines a weighted directed influence graph from decade-following, genre-following and influencer out-degree. It then motivates dimensionality reduction for high-dimensional music data and uses Bayes error to distinguish within-genre from between-genre distributions. The third perspective separates distinguishing characteristics from contagious characteristics by a one-at-a-time removal and p-value comparison, naming Energy/Valence/Speechiness versus Acousticness/Danceability/Valence. The final perspective combines modified closeness centrality for revolutionary artists with a discrete Fourier transform; the new sigma indicator turns low-frequency content into an interpretable time-series claim. This is a clear example of method handoff from graph construction to statistical comparison to frequency-domain interpretation. The closing text contains a broad sensitivity-analysis praise but no quantitative sensitivity result. No formula or figure interpretation;all printed glyphs and source wording retained.
